motion.name: orrery
motion.value: requestAnimationFrame elliptical orbits; t += dt * wind
motion.purpose: Live canvas orrery. One seeded frame when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

motion.name: wind
motion.value: target 3.4 on .key hover/focus, lerp 0.08 back to 1
motion.purpose: Winding the orrery from the hydrogen key. Disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Winding Key
components.description: Primary control: hydrogen rail with key glyph. Install on the landing, Download on install. Winds the orrery on hover.
components.html: InstallWind the orrery
components.css: .ds-key { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 24px; min-height: 80px; padding: 16px 24px; background: var(--hydrogen, #e85d4c); color: var(--paper, #dce6f0); font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; border-radius: 0; } .ds-key-glyph { display: block; width: 2.4rem; height: 2.4rem; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-key-label { font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.6rem); line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-key-hint { font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; opacity: 0.92; } .ds-key:hover, .ds-key:focus-visible { color: var(--void, #070b14); background: var(--paper, #dce6f0); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, #3ee0c4); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Continue
components.description: Inner-page and 404 pager. Cyan Archivo uppercase, no fill. Not hydrogen.
components.css: .ds-continue { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin: 64px 0 0; padding: 16px 0; color: var(--signal, #3ee0c4); font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; } .ds-continue-label { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 0.9; } .ds-continue:hover, .ds-continue:focus-visible { color: var(--paper, #dce6f0); } .ds-continue:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, #3ee0c4); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Nav Lane
components.description: Axis destination. Mute at rest; paper on hover; void on signal when current.
components.html: grantinstalldocs
components.css: .ds-lanes { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0; } .ds-lanes a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; background: transparent; color: var(--mute, color-mix(in srgb, #3ee0c4 48%, #070b14)); padding: 0 12px; font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; } .ds-lanes a:hover, .ds-lanes a:focus-visible { color: var(--paper, #dce6f0); } .ds-lanes a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, #3ee0c4); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-lanes a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--void, #070b14); background: var(--signal, #3ee0c4); }

components.css: .ds-lang { display: flex; } .ds-lang button { appearance: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--mute, color-mix(in srgb, #3ee0c4 48%, #070b14)); padding: 0 12px; font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; } .ds-lang button:hover, .ds-lang button:focus-visible { color: var(--paper, #dce6f0); } .ds-lang button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, #3ee0c4); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-lang button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--void, #070b14); background: var(--signal, #3ee0c4); }

narrative.overview:
The public site is a mechanical orrery in night ether, not an AI-OS product hero and not a radio correlator. A live canvas draws MEMORY, CAPS, GPU, and AGENTS on elliptical rails; capability rods run from the hub to each globe. The landing fold is that machine on the left and an honesty stack on the right: Fira lede, one cyan swipe of HOST / NVIDIA rec. / NOT BOOTABLE, then cut-face Host / NVIDIA / Boot on void. The hydrogen winding key sits flush on the bottom rail. Inner pages are the same ether dimmed, with copy and cut-face stacks on void.

Personality is precise and technical. Honesty about Preview (host app, NVIDIA recommended, not bootable) sits in the same register as the thesis. Density is instrument-like: an 8px unit, flush square chrome, Archivo Narrow on the machine. Confirmed rejections: an AI-OS hero, a spectrogram correlator, a split-flap board, and a card grid of features. The header is the circular A-mark plus the words Akasha OS — never Station.
keyCharacteristics: Night void field with a live canvas orrery (MEMORY, CAPS, GPU, AGENTS); plate weather dims the ether to 38% and tucks it to the corner
Archivo Narrow 700 on rails, swipe, headlines, and the winding key; Archivo Narrow 600 on canvas orbit IDs
Fira Sans 400 / 500 / 600 for lede, running copy, and honesty body
Hydrogen reserved for the Install / Download winding key
Honesty as one cyan swipe plus centered void stacks; inner pages continue in cyan, not hydrogen
Square bezels; integer unit `--u` (8px); two weathers (`body.sky` vs `body.plate`)

rules.name: The Hydrogen Key Rule
rules.body: Hydrogen fills the Install / Download winding key and nowhere else. Continue links, headings, the mark, and hover states stay cyan or paper.

rules.name: The Cyan Rail Rule
rules.body: If a control is idle, it sits on mute; if it is live, current, or a destination, it goes to signal — except the one hydrogen key.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Archivo Narrow speaks the machine (rails, swipe, titles, winding key, continue, Host / NVIDIA / Boot). Fira Sans speaks the log (lede, body, copy). Do not swap them.

rules.name: The Hidden Landing Title Rule
rules.body: On sky weather the h1 is a screen-reader title only. Do not paint collision-scale type over the orrery.

rules.name: The Two Weathers Rule
rules.body: body.sky is the night fold (full-bleed orrery, hydrogen key, no footer). body.plate is working copy: ether at 38% opacity, hub shifted to the corner, continue links instead of hydrogen — except install, which keeps the Download key. Do not run the sky fold layout on plate pages.

rules.name: The Cut-Face Rule
rules.body: Honesty stacks, grants, ticks, and chapter bands are separated by void gaps. Do not wrap them in a card grid or sit them on paper sheets.

rules.name: The Field Not Card Rule
rules.body: Do not lift content on drop shadows to imply cards. Do not sit honesty on paper sheets. The live orrery and tonal wells (8% signal mix under pre) carry depth.

rules.name: The Square Bezel Rule
rules.body: border-radius stays 0 on chrome. Instruments are milled square. Do not round keys, lanes, plates, or bands. Circles belong to the mark and the orrery, not to buttons.

dos: Do let the live orrery fill the sky fold; keep the landing h1 visually hidden.
Do put HOST / NVIDIA rec. / NOT BOOTABLE in one cyan swipe, then Host / NVIDIA / Boot on void.
Do keep hydrogen on the Install / Download winding key only; wind the orrery on key hover.
Do use cyan continue links on inner pages and 404.
Do set current nav and language as void type on a signal well.
Do use body.sky for the landing (and 404) and body.plate for procedures.
Do wrap running copy at 70ch; separate grants and chapters with void gutters.
donts: Don't build an AI-OS hero, a spectrogram correlator, a split-flap board, or a feature card grid.
Don't label the header Station; the wordmark is Akasha OS.
Don't use hydrogen for headings, links, continue, the mark, or hover states.
Don't round corners or lift plates on card shadows.
Don't put Archivo Narrow on plate captions, or Fira on the winding key.
Don't imply a bootable OS in chrome, imagery, or the swipe.
